DS3230 MG = actuation_trade.md 0 'wait' row (recommended) [S price/torque/mass, listing]; its body, ears, boss and shaft offset are not published and carry the DS3218MG values [A, measure on the delivered part]

_provenance.wrist_interface.horn_hole_depth: tolerance_stacks.md row 8 / rev_b.yaml horn_hole_depth: 3.75 is the MINIMUM the M3x6 needs, not a measurement; measure the real depth (DB M15) and pick wrist_mount.horn_screw_len by the rule in wrist_mount.horn_screw_rule [A]
_provenance.gear.face_width: actuation_trade.md 8 C1: 8 -> 10.5 mm for the DS3230 MG (jam-shock SF 1.01 at 8 -> 1.15 at 10.5); gears.py re-run at 10.5 [D]

DSServo DS3218MG._tags: S body 40.0 x 20.1 (servodatabase; 20.5 in actuators.csv A17 text) and ears 49.5 x 10 on 54.5; A case/boss split, ear height, shaft offset (M9); gear width 8 is rev A (actuation_trade.md: hold margin 1.03, does not qualify at 1:1)

measure_on_delivered_part: ear thickness and height below the case top
shaft offset from the outboard case end and from the case side
stall torque at 6.35 V >= 1.98 N m (actuation_trade.md 0 purchase gate)
DSServo DS3230 MG._tags: S price 27.00, 26/30 kg cm at 5.0/6.8 V, 60 g (aifitlab listing, actuation_trade.md A32); 6.5 V stall 29.33 kg cm = 2.877 N m [D linear]; body 40 x 20 x 40.5 listing rounded; every dimension here is the DS3218MG value [A], list measure_on_delivered_part

servo._doc: Case body_x (width) x body_y (length) x body_z (case height below the top face); overall 40.5 = case + 2.5 boss [A split]. servo.model picks one row of servo.models (copied over these keys by gripper_concept.resolve). long_axis X: case length along frame-G X, shaft 10 from the outboard (-X) end. Horn: 25T aluminium disc 20 x 3 [A] seated on the boss top (horn_gap = boss_h), 2 dog set screws at r 7.
servo.horn_screw: M3x6 ISO 7380 button head, 2.0 mm hex, replaces the Phillips centre screw (driven through the 3.0 pin A bore) [A]
servo.dog_pin: 2x custom M3x10 hardened shoulder dog screws: smooth Ø2.9 shoulder begins 0.1 mm below the horn face, threaded tail held in a hardened steel Ø6x3 insert [A; gauge and prove on coupon]

gear._doc: sector (deg) is the viewer's sector key (2 x A half angle); the CAD uses the DXF polygons GEAR_A / GEAR_B (world frame, pivots at -/+ a/2). Rev B: face_width follows servo.models[model].gear_face_width (10.5 for the DS3230 MG, actuation C1).

knuckle.pin_spec: ISO 2338 h8 3 x 16 (2.986-3.000), graded so each pin runs 0.000-0.020 in its pressed bush [tolerance row 2]

fsr._doc: Backing 1.5 total (1.0 under the FSR + 0.5 pocket); FSR head centred 9 mm above the tip (s 36), puck 6 dia at s 39 so it stays in the 12.7 active area [A]; nominal pad centroid s 40.

housing._doc: mount_d / mount_t kept for viewer.html only; the real mount is the wrist_mount block.
housing.cradle_pocket_rule: pocket width = servo.body_x (largest measured case width) + 2 x cradle_pocket_clear = width + 0.40 (tolerance row 3)

limiter.spec: brass or steel tube 5.0 x 3.2, cut to 2.55 (thermal.md C1) [A]

housing.peg_pin: 2 x ISO 2338 h8 3 x 6, bonded (retaining compound) in the spider, slip in the reamed Ø3.0 deck holes [tolerance row 5, bought in place of printed pegs]

wrist_mount.screw: 4x M3 pan head ISO 7045 into the horn, length per horn_screw_rule (M3x6 at a measured depth >= 3.75)
wrist_mount.deck_screw: 4x M3x6 pan head up through the deck into M3 heat-set inserts (4.2 x 3.5) in the spider
wrist_mount.horn_screw_rule: measure horn hole depth d (DB M15). Screw length L must give tip clearance d - (L - clamp_t) >= 0.2 and full-thread engagement L - clamp_t >= 1.5 + 0.5 lead: M3x6 needs d >= 3.75 (PASS), 3.5-3.7 MARGINAL (hand-check each head seats); d < 3.5: drill and re-tap the horn holes to >= 3.75 (T03/T03B, tolerance row 8)

camera_pad.primary_camera: fixed off-arm Pi Camera 3 (camera.md 0), 0 g on the arm
camera_pad.wrist_option: 32x32 UVC bracket on this pad, 16.3 g (not modelled)
camera_pad.camera_lane_status: pre-CAD: camera.md clearances and mass figure assume pivot-to-H 40.7 and pad u 27; CAD has 31.0 and u 20.7 (see _provenance.camera_pad)

materials._doc: PLA/TPU/print_fill are the densities (g/cm^3) and PLA fill that gripper_concept.py reads. Everything below is additive design data (MPa unless noted); owner docs/gripper/DESIGN-BASIS.md, numbers from docs/gripper/design_basis.py. TPU 95A TDS density is 1.22.

PLA.tag: S Bambu PLA Basic TDS; fatigue D Basquin fit (gears.md 2.1)

PETG.tag: S Bambu PETG Basic TDS; fatigue A (PLA ratio 0.60 x UTS)

PA6-CF.tag: S Bambu PA6-CF TDS (dried, annealed); fatigue S gear-level Onyx 57 MPa at 6.3e6 cycles (gears.md 3)

POM.tag: S DuPont Delrin design guide (machined); density A

TPU95A.tag: S Ultimaker TPU 95A TDS (0.4 mm core, 0.15 mm layers, 100 % infill) https://um-support-files.ultimaker.com/materials/2.85mm/tds/TPU-95A/Ultimaker-TPU95A-TDS-v5.00.pdf; poisson and strain limit A

grip._doc: Load cases LC1-LC4 in docs/gripper/DESIGN-BASIS.md. Contact = tip pad; r_c = perpendicular distance pivot -> pad-normal line of action (invariant with jaw angle).
grip.close_time_selection_basis_note: R19 value at actuator and concept selection; superseded as a requirement 2026-10-12. Douglas's 2026-10-12 ruling keeps the selected actuator, gear ratio, firmware and concept.

finger_roles.A: driven; stiff PLA tip nail 1.0 mm slides under the cloth edge
finger_roles.B: idler; FSR on the pad behind a rigid backing

fsr.backing: 1.0 mm PLA plate under, 6 mm dia puck over the active area

servo_design_point.note: bookkeeping choice; the W2a trade study owns the pick
servo_design_point.stall_source: servo.stall_torque_kgcm 6.5V (linear interpolation of actuators.csv A17 5.0/6.8 V) [D]

gearmotor_fallback.rule: Pololu HPCB 380:1 gearbox limit 2.5 kg*cm: add >= 4:1 stage (>= 6.3:1 if the gearbox must carry the cap) or a worm

payload_scenarios._doc: Static shoulder_lift check at full horizontal extension (MuJoCo so101_old_calib.xml, qfrc_bias) plus feed-pose sweep. Arm joints hold <= 50 % of stall.

wrist_interface._doc: SO-101 wrist-roll horn (servo 5) interface, frame I of docs/gripper/research/so101.md; z measured from horn face H (H is z = +1.0 in frame I). The concept housing.mount_* keys (32 mm square, 20 mm BC) are superseded by this block.
wrist_interface.screw: M3x6 pan head, DIN EN ISO 7045
wrist_interface.camera_mount_stock: 2x M3 through holes with hex-nut recesses; the new housing replicates an M3 camera mount if the wrist camera is kept
wrist_interface.horn_hole_depth_note: minimum for M3x6 (rev_b.yaml assumes it), not a measurement: measure (DB M15) and see wrist_mount.horn_screw_rule

work_cell._doc: Assumed work cell (A unless tagged). Reference machine Singer 4423 (S singer.com product page).

mcu.adc_rule: analog inputs on ADC1 pins only (ADC2 is unavailable while Wi-Fi runs)
mcu.servo_current_sense: INA219 on I2C, high side of the 6.5 V servo rail (stall and hold-current detection)

power.logic: USB 5 V to the DevKit regulator

mcu.uno_differences: 5 V logic, 10-bit ADC, Servo.h disables analogWrite on pins 9 and 10, external interrupts only on D2/D3, 2 KB SRAM, no Wi-Fi
